Dr. Steven Greer joins Danny Jones to warn that the most feared UFO tech has slipped from US military hands. Greer is a long-time UFO activist who claims briefings with top officials. He brings an alarm to this talk.

Greer argues that craft and tech held in black programs have leaked to foes or rogue groups. He names the risks he sees if such tech is used in war. Jones asks what proof he can lay on the table. Listeners get Greer's claim at full strength, from the man himself. The library holds the episode as an archive record, without a side taken.
